name: sanctions-watchlist-monitor
title: Sanctions Watchlist Monitor: OFAC Alerts
description: Re-screen your wallets and names against OFAC sanctions lists on a schedule and get alerted only when something changes. Ongoing screening for crypto businesses, payments and compliance teams.

watchlistName.title: Watchlist name
watchlistName.description: Keeps results for this list between runs. Use a different name for each separate watchlist.

wallets.title: Wallets to watch
wallets.description: Crypto wallet addresses, one per line.

names.title: Names to watch
names.description: People, companies, vessels or aircraft, one per line.

webhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: We POST a JSON alert here when any item's status changes (Slack, Zapier, Make and n8n webhooks all work).

alertOn.title: Alert when
alertOn.description: When to send the webhook alert.
